_comment: Repositories the integration job checks out that this repository does not
pin as a submodule. Two exist: chiplet-spec, the upstream of the reader
copies the tools vendor, which the image stages instead (staging.pin's
header and chiplet-spec entry say why), and IHP-Open-ADK-docs, whose requirements file is one of
the places the ecosystem's KLayout version is declared.
They are pinned for the same reason the submodules are pinned: a required
check that follows a branch head goes red because somebody else pushed, on
a pull request that changed nothing. Bumping a pin is then a deliberate
commit that says which combination was checked, which is what this
chiplet-spec carries no pin of its own. The image stages it, and staging.pin's
chiplet-spec entry is its one pin (pin_from); on_remote records whether that
commit has been pushed to the remote named here. While it is false, the
integration job refuses rather than test another commit. ci/pin_set.py joins
this file with staging.pin, the gitlinks and the Dockerfile into
ci/pin-set.json, which is what every consumer reads.
The floating weekly run ignores the pins and takes the branch heads, so a
pin going stale is visible without being blocking.
